rows: In CBSE's 2026 scheme, as reported by All India Radio, a student with a compartment result can sit the second exam in the compartment category to clear the subject not passed.
Ask your school for the second-exam form date and the subjects you are eligible to re-sit.
Failed three or more subjects (essential repeat)

All India Radio reported CBSE saying that students who miss three or more subjects in the first exam are not eligible for the second exam and are placed in Essential Repeat. The report does not say whether 'miss' means failing or being absent, so ask your school.
Repeat Class 10, take a private route where the board allows it, or move to NIOS Secondary.
Passed theory but missed internal or practical marks
CBSE bye-law 40.1, as read by the Delhi High Court, asks for 33 percent in theory and in practical or internal assessment separately. Check whether that applies to the subject you failed.
Ask the school which component you failed and whether the second exam covers it.
Each board has its own supplementary rules, names and dates. The CBSE details above do not transfer.
Read your own board's circular and ask the school office for the form deadline.
